en.headline: Girl, 11, in intensive care with flu and severe pneumonia
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child has a chronic illness, tested positive for influenza A H1, and had not had this season's vaccine.
body: The Centre for Health Protection said an 11-year-old girl with a chronic illness had been diagnosed with influenza A complicated by severe pneumonia and was in serious condition in a paediatric intensive care unit.

The centre said she developed a cough on 29 September and a fever the next day. On Saturday she went to a private clinic with shortness of breath and vomiting and was referred to the Queen Mary Hospital emergency department. A respiratory sample was positive for influenza A (H1).

She had not travelled during the incubation period and had not received the 2026/27 seasonal flu vaccine, the centre said. One household contact had a mild upper-respiratory illness and has recovered.

Director Edwin Tsui said Hong Kong had been in the flu season since late June and that activity remained high. The centre recorded three serious paediatric flu cases in the past five days and 23 since the season began. Since schools reopened in September it had received nearly 370 reports of influenza-like outbreaks affecting about 2,200 people. Tsui said activity was expected to stay high in the coming weeks.

zh.headline: 11歲女童染甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心稱，該名有長期病患的女童對甲型H1流感呈陽性，未接種本季流感疫苗，現於兒童深切治療部留醫。
body: 衞生防護中心表示，一名有長期病患的11歲女童確診甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎，現於兒童深切治療部留醫，情況嚴重。
中心稱，女童上月29日出現咳嗽，翌日發燒，上周六因呼吸急促和嘔吐到私家診所求醫，被轉介至瑪麗醫院急症室留院。呼吸道樣本對甲型H1流感病毒呈陽性。
初步調查顯示，她在潛伏期內沒有外遊，亦未接種2026/27年度季節性流感疫苗。一名家居接觸者近日曾出現輕微上呼吸道症狀，現已康復。
中心總監徐樂堅表示，本港自6月下旬進入流感季節，活躍程度仍處高水平。過去五日錄得3宗兒童嚴重個案，今季累計23宗。9月開學後接獲近370宗學校流感樣疾病爆發報告，影響約2200人。他預計未來數周活躍程度仍會在高水平波動。
